key_insight: A general-purpose language model can directly write a small neural network’s weights to rank materials without property labels and improve early-stage discovery.
engineering_relevance: These label-free networks can initialize surrogate models and screen generated crystals when measurements are scarce.
method: Provide a task description, input names and a zero-initialized network with 16 hidden units.
Have the language model fill in every network weight directly as text.
Use the network for ranking, as a Bayesian model’s prior mean or as a crystal-generation screen.
evidence_signal: The strongest model achieved zero-label Spearman correlations of 0.64–0.79 on experimental alloys and 0.95 on generated crystals; as a Gaussian-process prior mean, it improved five-label rankings from 0.35 to 0.69 and 0.15 to 0.95, respectively.
watch_item: Benefits are concentrated in the first tens of labels and on targets not already ranked well by simple rules or subsystem extrapolation.
